boundaries.name: canonical_abi_and_storage
boundaries.obligation: Nat inputs/observations stand for canonical Solidity address/uint32/uint64/uint256 values and valid projection of reachable storage; no generic arbitrary-Nat source refinement is claimed.

boundaries.name: constructor_and_authority_provenance
boundaries.obligation: Constructor chain/verifier pinning, immutable deployer/adapter provenance, set-once materializer discovery/binding, registered Manager authority and their callbacks must be established separately; their bodies are untranslated here.

boundaries.name: external_call_and_staticcall_semantics
boundaries.obligation: Environment supplies the exact typed recipient/token/amount and pre-call storage to external calls. Success/failure, EVM call frame isolation, STATICCALL restrictions, and returned callback-mutated storage require independent semantics.

boundaries.name: safe_erc20_and_actual_custody
boundaries.obligation: SafeERC20 acceptance, token code behavior, balanceOf truthfulness, native actual balances/value transfer and conservation of external custody are not inferred from local ledger arithmetic.

boundaries.name: callback_storage_frames
boundaries.obligation: Full-call accounting across callbacks requires the stated local storage-frame premise; nonReentrant blocks only guarded reentry and does not prove all callback storage immutable.

boundaries.name: outer_transaction_atomicity
boundaries.obligation: commit is an explicit all-or-nothing projected storage/log semantics. EVM rollback of nested materializer complete-vector calls, token balances and callee logs is not proved.

boundaries.name: rollup_own_event_projection
boundaries.obligation: Returned events include only final-success Rollup-owned events; callee logs and callback-relative global event order are not modeled. Solidity withdrawToken emits before external balance/transfer calls.

boundaries.name: hash_abi_memory_and_storage_layout
boundaries.obligation: Typed hash constructors name exact ordered roles/widths. Actual big-endian serialization, Keccak collision resistance, assembly memory writes, mapping-slot addressing and layout are not proved.

boundaries.name: compact_withdrawal_proof_soundness
boundaries.obligation: Pinned compact adapter output authenticates correct circuit public inputs and economic entitlement only under separately proved adapter/circuit/cryptographic assumptions. Length/mask/hash checks alone do not prove soundness.

boundaries.name: historical_finality_provenance
boundaries.obligation: The finalizedRoot membership predicate and its permanence originate in untranslated constructor/finality paths. This module faithfully accepts historical membership but does not establish valid chain finality.

boundaries.name: bounded_limb_helper_domain
boundaries.obligation: Limb helpers are represented for length17, offsets0/8, eight iterations. Solidity generic out-of-bounds panics and arbitrary offsets are not modeled by their total List projections.

boundaries.name: pooled_escrow_and_selected_transition_scope
boundaries.obligation: Escrow is token-indexed and pooled, pending credits are recipient-indexed. Proven other-token/recipient framing does not establish L2 channel ownership or prevent one authorized channel from claiming another's pooled entitlement. Materializer/Manager vector entitlement, stake paths and full lifecycle composition are outside scope.

boundaries.name: resource_and_evm_refinement
boundaries.obligation: Gas exhaustion, integer ABI decoder failures, array allocation, compiler behavior and full EVM small-step refinement are not proved. This manually authored model is not extracted or proven equivalent to Solidity.
